# the contributor audit: actual middle-support potentials on the complete three-fiber chain

Source: `candidate 9846569646342882`. Independent full audit: **PASS**. the contributor reran the exact polygon verifier: 96 cap, coarea, flux, support and potential checks pass.

The section's actual base moment forces equal endpoint coarea weights; the circuit normalization then gives T0=-2T. The sum of threshold terms B_p is zero only after using both the base moment and b_j=v_j dot y. The formal three-optimizer sum dQ+2[h_M0(-T)+h_K(T)] is therefore exact. Each support optimizer exists in its compact actual fiber, but the proof correctly avoids identifying their independent sum with an admissible middle-localizing potential.

The center-triangle construction remedies part of that obstruction. Its support scalar is concave in the real base coordinate and is the actual section support of the triangle with the three chosen lifted vertices. That triangle is contained in C by convexity. Consequently its positive-part potential is admissible and is nonnegative without clipping on the measured normal bundles. The affine-center baseline has weighted integral dQ even if its middle center differs from y: the remaining common displacement cancels by sum theta_j S_j v_j=0. The denominator after subtracting the middle hemisphere remains positive because both endpoint radial integrals remain d times their positive volumes.

The middle cap vector flux has sign +sigma_j v_j, hence L_minus-L_plus=-D dot T0=2G. This is the correct sign and exact hemispheric distinction. The criterion gamma J-L_plus>=d(gamma V-Q) is only an algebraic equivalent of paying gamma; its favorable sign is not inferred from G>=0.

The second normal-dependent affine hinge vanishes exactly on endpoint normal bundles and equals the actual middle support slack h_K-h_M0 on the middle bundle. The denominator is the displayed surface-area integral. The strict-inclusion/zero-denominator example is valid: truncating a corner of a triangle leaves contact with each of its three facet support lines, while giving a genuinely smaller midpoint body. Thus zero slack on the surface-measure support is not equivalent to equality of the bodies.

The explicit triangle-middle/rectangular-endpoints calibration is genuinely globally critical. Central symmetry pairs the two endpoint contributions for every oblique cap through the middle centroid, and the middle triangle supplies its exact centroid bound. The three displayed caps and endpoint-isolating vertical caps give the matching global upper bound. All sections are proper and their summed centroids are the stated source. Independent checks confirm theta=(4/11,3/11,4/11), T=(0,1/33), the three optimized numerators, J=3/4, L_plus=7/22, L_minus=4/11 and the actual center-triangle efficiency94/187. Its depth5/11 is explicitly above the OC target.

The construction is a new actual directional mechanism on {-1,0,1}. It does not supply a quantitative Gamma theorem, replace arbitrary integer bases by a three-point chain, or dispose of nonsmooth profile allocations.
